scope: Independent read-only audit of the uncommitted main observation export contract, product reader, authenticated Hono route, transport, React download hook and actual TrialWorkspace button wiring. Pure contract/transport/Hono and React/jsdom probes only; no listening server, browser runtime, model, native process, lifecycle signal or user state change.
positiveObservations: ProductUsageObservation.download invokes a fresh authorized read rather than exporting stale page state. The snapshot identity, observedAt, project scope, days and timezone travel in both envelope and text.
The product reader reuses configured project-scoped evidence readers, retains its work/record/byte/deadline limits and guards scope changes. The export component has no writer or execution port.

The normal producer uses the strict display-only serializer, copies formatted strings without fabricating numeric values, bounds the file at 65536 bytes and computes SHA256 over the exact serialized UTF8 text.

The export route is under the existing authentication/origin middleware. It rejects duplicate/unknown query fields through the strict observation query parser, checks selected project/days/timezone and returns cache-control no-store.
HttpTransport checks the response query identity and exact UTF8 SHA256 digest before returning download data. Optional absence remains compatible with older servers.

The actual App passes observationDownload.download to TrialWorkspace. Its Download icon has an accessible label and fresh-snapshot tooltip, and is disabled while observations/downloads are pending or the current observation is unavailable.

The hook suppresses duplicate in-flight requests, aborts on identity/project/window/configuration/enable changes, checks the current identity before Blob creation, removes the temporary link and schedules URL revocation. Controlled late-response probes did not download stale data.

closedFinding.originalIssue: The nested text parser accepted unknown top-level fields and arbitrary row metadata while retaining the original text. It checked rowId/formatted but not layer/unit/sampleCount/detail/header/truncation. A matching digest proved bytes, not the claimed sanitized display semantics.

closedFollowup.mainCorrectionReviewed: For a byBytes declaration the final schema reconstructs the next original DTO metric row, resolves pretty-encoded byte accounting to a fixed point and refuses an omission when that row fits the public65536-byte budget.
